review: Read three production modules and two tests in full. First-party React projection and mocked activity fixtures; no live grants, profile state, credentials, assets or private history copied.

An approved stream keeps its collector enabled while the Float is hidden. Displaying a Float is separate from collecting activity. Source reads are sequential and account/device/exact-read-grant authorization remains with the native host.
Native frames must parse and match the requested source reference. Failed reads are omitted rather than replayed from cache. Disabled or disposed collectors do not commit late results.

Session projection rejects terminal pairings and mismatched exact task IDs. Verified native reads can remain visible when a separate registration badge is unavailable; reconnecting frames retain their explicit status.

Adapter and Responses records require matching chat, binding, epoch and run with sanitized profile visibility. Records remain attributed observations, not proof of a live worker or performed movement. Saved chat names are discovery hints, not authority.

Tests cover projection attribution, task mismatch, revoked pairing, epoch isolation and background collector activation. The collector is mocked by the owner-component test; native polling behavior is not independently qualified by this suite.
No canonical edits in this cohort. Line-ending normalization is the only export transformation.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal, not a package or deployment.
Shared contracts, the native reader, type-only saved-activity definitions and server test normalizer remain separate dependencies.
Mock source tests do not prove installed background delivery, live source authorization, Discord receipt or game behavior.
